verdict.summary: The change correctly centralizes runtime SIMD dispatch in active_kernel(), preserves the existing architecture-specific feature checks before unsafe intrinsic calls, and adds a non-vacuity test that fails closed in CI when AVX2+FMA coverage is required but unavailable. The test exercises the real dispatcher and rechecks representative body/drain/tail dimensions against the independent f64 reference. Documentation and the unsafe register are consistent with the implementation; no correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect was found.
